questions.actual_answer: The Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972 provides for the payment of gratuity at the rate of fifteen days wages for each completed year of service, subject to a maximum of rupees two lakh [1].

questions.question: How many days of earned leave can industrial employees accumulate, and how much can be encashed during service?
questions.expected_answer: Up to 300 days; encash up to 60 days while availing leave travel concession
questions.actual_answer: Industrial employees may be permitted to accumulate up to 300 days of earned leave, and can encash up to 60 days of the leave accumulated during their entire service while availing of leave travel concession for travel anywhere in the country [2].

questions.question: What ex-gratia amount does the Golden Handshake Scheme give employees identified as surplus?
questions.expected_answer: 1.5 months of emoluments (Pay + DA) per completed year of service or remaining service before retirement, whichever is lower

questions.question: Which Supreme Court case on pensions is cited, and what did the Court hold about the nature of pension?
questions.expected_answer: D.S. Nakara v. Union of India; pension is not a bounty or ex-gratia payment but a payment for past services
questions.actual_answer: The landmark Supreme Court case cited is D.S. Nakara and others vs. Union of India [2], [3]. The Court held that pension is neither a bounty nor a matter of grace depending upon the sweet will of the employer, but rather a payment for past services rendered and a statutory, inalienable, legally enforceable right earned by the employee [1], [3].
